scope: Basic native Windows printing; no release or merge approval

implementation.dialog: HWND-owned PrintDlgW with a cancellation capture hook; no custom controls or runtime fallback
implementation.producer: PDF.js print intent, 300 DPI, intrinsic rotation, opaque BGRA
implementation.successMeaning: Submitted to the native consumer, not verified physical delivery
implementation.rendererReservation: 2 * RGBA bytes + 32-byte header; canvas zeroed before payload allocation
implementation.concurrency: One process-wide print job; one page handoff; native copy admission before cloning or queuing
implementation.paperPolicy: Preserve page aspect and intrinsic orientation, fit to user-selected printable paper bounds

verification.frontend: npm test -- --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1: 1000 tests passed in 90 files, no unhandled errors
verification.nativeTests: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --jobs 1: 179 top-level tests plus 2 nested helper invocations passed
verification.fixtureCoverage: Consumer header/pixel sentinels at 1/12/24/25/30/300; mixed dimensions/rotation; cancellation, backpressure, raw ownership, allocation failures, timeouts and malformed acknowledgments
verification.nativeInput: Explicit WebView2 CDP trusted Ctrl+P events through the production action registry, followed by real Windows dialogs and GDI
verification.printer: Microsoft Print to PDF selection verified before every Print action
verification.nativeSaveAsCancel: Passed; cancelled terminal result and no output submission
verification.sameSessionCancelReopen: Passed; two distinct job IDs and two native releases
verification.rawArtifacts: Retained locally under .internal/evidence/issue-83/native; output PDFs are not committed

outputs.identityMethod: Every output page's printed number matched its unique fixed-source pixel template; no OCR
Each output matched the correct source page and orientation among all four rotations of every source page

historicalBaseline.kind: Real PDF.js/canvas/PNG browser preparation, not native dialog timing
historicalBaseline.coldDefinition: Fresh document pages, not OS-cold cache
historicalBaseline.candidateChange: All page rendering and encoding removed from the pre-dialog path; PNG encoding removed entirely

postIntegration.codeReview: CLEAR after sticky session print invalidation and locked admission recheck
postIntegration.blankAndMixedPixelVerification: Passed on the rebased 0.1.2 QA build

limitations: OS foreground keyboard activation could not be established by the harness. CDP delivery is explicit and is not OS keyboard/focus proof.
Native dialog observation includes approximately one-second UI automation polling overhead. Admission time is not visible-dialog time.
No equivalent native baseline was captured; browser baseline timing is not substituted for it.
300-page debug output took about 455 seconds. No faster total-printing claim is made.
Process-tree working-set/private-byte samples are not the renderer reservation counter and do not include independent spooler allocations. Working sets can count shared pages more than once.
1/12-page outputs precede the final two-buffer allocation refinement; 300/mixed outputs use the final two-buffer build. The refinement changes allocation lifetime, not pixel payloads.
User-selected paper is preserved; mixed source media boxes are aspect-fit, not reproduced as mixed physical paper sizes.
Physical printer, native monitor DPI/text scaling, Narrator, clean-machine installer and OS foreground focus gates remain unclaimed.

Bulk 12/300-page outputs were captured before final renderer-invalidation fencing and upstream integration; their page-payload path is unchanged. Blank/mixed outputs and cancel/reopen were reverified on the rebased build.
No PR merge, tag, signing or release is authorized by this evidence.
